reviews.title: Great motherboard
reviews.comment: It's a great value from a good company that makes very reliable motherboards. The BIOS needed to be updated but that's because of the weirdness with the Intel I-9 14 generation. After that was all updated the board is Rock solid and performance is good and it's a good value.
reviews.author: Richard A. Young

reviews.title: Works as described
reviews.comment: Works as described.  I did have to fight some electrical interference/feedback sounds coming out of my speakers after setting this up, but I can't be sure if it's the built-in soundcard that is contributing to this or just my setup.
reviews.author: Russell & Amber Bohlmann

reviews.title: Very Nice quality for the price!
reviews.comment: Upgraded my little brothers computer with this and its definitely noticeable. For a cheaper build this motherboard is pretty awesome and has an awesome aesthetic too! i would definitely recommend it to anyone who's doing a build. Its a pretty quick startup and has the standard amount of USB ports as well.
reviews.author: Adrian

reviews.title: Feels high quality, works well, looks great
reviews.comment: Good performance and awesome to get an mATX motherboard at this cost with many modern features such as DDR5 support. Everything looks and feels high quality even down to the m.2 NVME heatsink. The boot menu has a lot of options and is relatively easy to navigate, with some exceptions (if you have a hard time finding an option, just search it online). I recommend this for mATX builds especially if you are going for a white aesthetic.
reviews.author: Renee S
